llm.summary: This is a disclosed Notion connector skill that reads and changes Notion content through OOMOL's oo CLI with user confirmation required for writes and deletes.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Notion automation, and the documented actions are Notion read, search, create, update, move, and archive/delete operations, which fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions consistently tell the agent to inspect the live schema, use oo connector commands for the Notion service, and confirm exact payloads before state-changing or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is markdown-only and has no executable bundled installer, but its first-time setup suggests installing the oo CLI via OOMOL-hosted shell commands if the CLI is missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires Notion account connection and can access or modify workspace data, but that access is disclosed and proportionate for a Notion management skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, local indexing, credential scraping, or privilege escalation is present; credentials are described as handled server-side by OOMOL rather than exposed to the agent.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that connecting this skill gives the agent Notion read and write capability through your OOMOL-connected account. Use it only with a Notion workspace you trust it to manage, review proposed payloads before approving writes, and require explicit confirmation for archive/delete operations.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector-clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review likewise found coherent, purpose-aligned Notion connector instructions.
[VirusTotal-clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious detections across the supplied engines.
[StaticScan-markdown-only] expected: The artifact contains markdown instructions and action references only, with no bundled executable scripts.
